Company.info: Classic corporations & companies limited by shares (Inc.,Ltd.,SA,GmbH, AG) plus LLCs, LLPs, GPs, LPs when the regulation treats them identically to companies for that obligation

PE.info: Permanent Establishment, a foreign branch or construction / service PE that is taxed as part of the head‑office company.

Partnership.info: Partnerships that remain fiscally transparent / taxed at partner‑level and to which the rule specifically applies or specifically exempts (GP, LP, LLP).

TrustFoundation.info: Trusts, foundations, charities if they are singled out.

Other.info: Catch‑all for rare or country‑specific forms, such as co‑operatives, state bodies, joint ventures or anything else explicitly mentioned but not fitting neatly above. Should be specifed in 'Entity Type Details'.
